gap: No result ChatGPT got states same-day seller prices for every wireless candidate and which variant of each is actually under $50: on 2026-11-21 the ATK A87 is $29.98 at ATK's store (ChatGPT showed $34.98), the Redragon K526 Pro is $34.99 at Redragon's store (ChatGPT showed $39.99), the Rosewill Neon S75 is $59.99 at Rosewill's own store and under $50 only as the black brown-switch Amazon listing at $37.99, and the Redragon K530 Pro is under $50 only in white ($49.99) or the strap version ($46.99) while the black versions are $54.99.
standout_why: Compared against mkbguide.com (cited), rottenwifi.com (cited), official.deals under-50 and mechvibes.com. mkbguide states no prices at all, and only 2 of its 8 boards are wireless (RK61, Redragon K556 Dharma TKL). rottenwifi is mostly wired boards; it prices the RK61 at $49.99 and gives the K530 Pro only as 'about $35-$45 in current roundups'. official.deals lists dated prices with sellers (RK61 $39.99 and $42.39 on Amazon, RK98 $47.99) but no downsides and no hot-swap status. mechvibes has four boards, two of them wired, and the RK61 at $49.99. None of the four names the ATK A87, Rosewill Neon S75, DAREU FLEX75, Redragon K526 Pro, Redragon S136 or any Gamakay board, and none gives per-variant prices. Rivals have part of it only for the RK61.
decides: It confirms ChatGPT's pick and sharpens it. The ATK A87 is the lowest-priced tri-mode hot-swap board among the sellers I read ($29.98 at ATK, 12,000 mAh per ATK). The finding removes or narrows three of ChatGPT's other cards: the Neon S75 qualifies only as one Amazon variant, the K530 Pro only in white or strap versions, and the RK61 sits one cent under the line at $49.99 with a 1,450 mAh battery. For our rows, the Redragon S136 combo (K628 PRO 75% keyboard plus mouse) is $35.99 on Amazon today, so it belongs on the page as the keyboard-and-mouse segment. The Gamakay TK101 (98%, $47.99 in the brief's partner-store read of 2026-11-21) is the candidate for the number-pad segment, but I could not re-open its page (HTTP 429), so its specs need a read before it gets a record. All our other linked keyboards are over $50 (Gamakay NS75 at $63.99 is the nearest).
